fullDescription: A vintage MONOCHROME newspaper-front-page editorial POSTER (A3 portrait) — near-black #141210 ink on a cream newsprint ground #f7f4ec, no color, no imagery. Three type families in high contrast: a high-contrast serif PLAYFAIR DISPLAY masthead nameplate (~138px, between a double rule), a heavy CONDENSED grotesque ANTON headline (~89px all-caps), Anton column sub-headers (~32px), and a justified Playfair serif body (~17px, multi-column). Structured entirely by hairline RULES: a top edition bar with mirrored labels, a three-up dateline with an italic tagline, a Public Sans eyebrow, and a three-column body split by vertical rules, closed by a footer line. Reusable for any vintage broadsheet / arts-culture / exhibition / zine poster.

structured.summary: A vintage NEWSPAPER-FRONT-PAGE editorial POSTER on a single A3-PORTRAIT page, built so the entire personality is ONE INK (near-black #141210) on a cream NEWSPRINT ground #f7f4ec — strictly MONOCHROME, and in this variant NO imagery at all, so the page is entirely type + rules. Poster padding ~53px/~58px. Three type families carry it with HIGH CONTRAST: a MASTHEAD nameplate in a high-contrast serif (Playfair Display 700) ~138px, centered, letter-spacing 0.02em, line-height 1 (the engraved-nameplate voice); a MAIN HEADLINE in a heavy CONDENSED grotesque sans (Anton) ~89px, ALL CAPS, centered, line-height 0.94 (the one loud voice, maximal contrast against the delicate serif); COLUMN SUB-HEADERS in Anton ~32px all-caps; and all BODY/lede/columns in Playfair Display ~17-25px, JUSTIFIED, in a dense multi-column setting. A small EYEBROW in Public Sans 700 ~18px, wide-tracked (0.34em) all-caps, centered. Layout top-to-bottom: (1) a TOP RULE row (border-top 2px + border-bottom 1px) with a small-caps serif label mirrored left and right ('Cultural Archives Edition'), letter-spacing 0.18em; (2) the MASTHEAD very large centered, followed by a triple/DOUBLE horizontal rule (border-top 3px double); (3) a DATELINE ROW three-up: 'Est. MCMXXIV' small-caps left, an italic serif tagline center (~21px), a date small-caps right; (4) the wide-tracked Public Sans EYEBROW; (5) the huge Anton HEADLINE (1-2 lines); (6) a justified Playfair LEDE (~25px, line-height 1.5) full width; (7) a THREE-COLUMN body (grid) separated by thin vertical HAIRLINE RULES (border-left 1px #cfc9ba), each column an Anton all-caps sub-header + justified Playfair body (~17px, #2a2622); (8) a FOOTER rule row three-up (price / publication / page number, ~17px, letter-spacing 0.16em). Horizontal + vertical HAIRLINE RULES do all structural work — no boxes, no fills, no color, no photos. Cinematic vintage broadsheet, high craft.

style.description: One-ink vintage broadsheet — near-black on cream newsprint, strictly monochrome, and in this variant entirely type + rules (no imagery). The whole idea is a TYPE CONTRAST: a delicate high-contrast serif nameplate (Playfair Display) against a heavy CONDENSED grotesque-sans headline (Anton), with Playfair setting the justified multi-column body and a wide-tracked Public Sans eyebrow. Structure comes entirely from RULES — a top rule, a double-rule nameplate, vertical column rules, a footer rule — rather than boxes or fills. No color, no shadows, no rounded shapes; a print-poster register, dense and editorial.
style.prompt: Design a single A3-PORTRAIT vintage newspaper-front-page editorial POSTER as a generically-branded original. Make the entire personality ONE INK: near-black #141210 type and rules on a cream NEWSPRINT ground #f7f4ec; NO color and NO imagery anywhere — the page is entirely type and rules. Build a high-contrast type system: a MASTHEAD nameplate in a high-contrast serif (Playfair Display 700) ~138px centered; a MAIN HEADLINE in a heavy CONDENSED grotesque sans (Anton) ~89px ALL CAPS centered; column SUB-HEADERS in Anton ~32px all-caps; a wide-tracked EYEBROW in Public Sans 700 ~18px (letter-spacing 0.34em); and all BODY/lede/columns in Playfair Display ~17-25px JUSTIFIED in a dense multi-column setting. Let RULES do the structure — a top rule (2px+1px), a signature DOUBLE-RULE under the nameplate (border-top 3px double), thin vertical hairlines (1px #cfc9ba) between columns, and a footer rule — with no boxes, no fills, no shadows, no rounded corners. It must read as an original vintage arts/culture broadsheet: invent the masthead name and all copy.

layout_and_structure.description: A single A3-portrait poster on cream newsprint, ~53px/~58px padding, entirely type + rules. Top to bottom: a top rule row with mirrored small-caps edition labels; a large Playfair masthead centered above a double rule; a three-up dateline (Est. year | italic tagline | date); a wide-tracked Public Sans eyebrow; a huge Anton all-caps headline; a justified Playfair lede; a three-column body divided by vertical hairline rules, each column an Anton sub-header + justified Playfair body; and a footer rule row three-up. On a narrow viewport the columns collapse to one, the masthead and headline step down, and the rules stay hairline.

prompts.prompt: At the very top, a TOP RULE row: border-top 2px + border-bottom 1px near-black, padding ~13px, holding a small-caps Playfair label on the LEFT and the same label mirrored on the RIGHT ('Cultural Archives Edition'), ~18px, letter-spacing 0.18em, uppercase. Directly below, the MASTHEAD paper-name in Playfair Display 700, ~138px, centered, letter-spacing 0.02em, line-height 1, near-black — followed by a DOUBLE horizontal rule (border-top 3px double) as the signature nameplate divider.

Under the nameplate, a DATELINE ROW three-up baseline-aligned in Playfair ~18px: 'Est. MCMXXIV' small-caps left, an ITALIC serif tagline centered (~21px), a date small-caps right. Below it, a single wide-tracked Public Sans 700 EYEBROW line centered, ~18px, letter-spacing 0.34em, uppercase (e.g. 'A CELEBRATION OF CREATIVE EXPRESSION & INDUSTRIAL GRACE').

A huge MAIN HEADLINE in Anton (heavy CONDENSED grotesque) ~89px, ALL CAPS, centered, line-height 0.94, on 1-2 lines — the one loud voice, in maximal contrast to the delicate serif above it. Directly beneath, a short justified LEDE in Playfair Display ~25px, line-height 1.5, full width.

A THREE-COLUMN body (CSS grid) above a border-top 1px rule, each column padded ~21px and separated by thin vertical HAIRLINE RULES (border-left 1px #cfc9ba). Each column: an Anton ~32px ALL-CAPS sub-header + justified Playfair ~17px body (color #2a2622, line-height 1.55). Close the poster with a FOOTER rule row (border-top 1px, padding-top ~15px) three-up in Playfair ~17px, letter-spacing 0.16em, uppercase (price / publication / page number).

special_ui_components.description: The engraved newspaper masthead: a high-contrast serif paper-name over a double rule.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build a newspaper NAMEPLATE: a paper-name in a high-contrast serif (Playfair Display 700), very large (~138px), centered, letter-spacing 0.02em, line-height 1, near-black on cream, followed by a DOUBLE horizontal rule (border-top 3px double). This is the delicate-serif voice that the condensed-sans headline contrasts against — the poster's signature.

special_ui_components.description: The core type-contrast system that defines the whole poster.
special_ui_components.prompt: Pair a delicate high-contrast serif (Playfair Display) for the masthead and small-caps labels with a heavy CONDENSED grotesque sans (Anton) for the main headline and column sub-headers, and Playfair for the justified body. Drive all hierarchy from this family contrast plus size — no color, no weight tricks beyond the families themselves.

special_ui_components.description: A top rule row with the same small-caps label mirrored left and right.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a TOP RULE row (border-top 2px + border-bottom 1px) with a wide-tracked small-caps Playfair label on the LEFT and the identical label mirrored on the RIGHT (letter-spacing 0.18em, uppercase). Restrained and symmetric — a vintage-broadsheet header cue with no ornament.

special_ui_components.description: A row carrying founding year, an italic tagline, and a date.
special_ui_components.prompt: Set a DATELINE ROW three-up in Playfair ~18px: a small-caps 'Est. <year>' on the left, a centered ITALIC serif tagline (~21px) in the middle, and a small-caps date on the right. Even baseline, generous letter-spacing on the small caps — a classic broadsheet dateline.

special_ui_components.description: A dense three-column newspaper body divided only by thin vertical rules.
special_ui_components.prompt: Lay out a THREE-COLUMN body (CSS grid) separated ONLY by thin vertical HAIRLINE RULES (border-left 1px #cfc9ba, no gutters-as-boxes, no fills). Justify the Playfair body text, lead each column with an Anton all-caps sub-header (~32px), and keep the rhythm dense and editorial. Above it a border-top rule, below it a footer rule row — rules do all the structure, no imagery.
